messages:
olivia-sales: Quick alert — client NimbusPoc on staging reported a flood of 429s during a background ingest + live chat in their demo. Roughly 2.3k 429s in the last 12m. Demo in 40m. Anyone who can triage? :grimacing:
ben-eng: Ill take a look. Can you paste one of the 429 response headers and the request_id?
olivia-sales: Support pasted: req_id=nimbus-449-xx, route=/v1/embeddings, status=429, headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining:0, X-RateLimit-Reset:2965432400, body:{\"error\":\"rate_limited\",\"retry_after\":0.8}
rahul-sre: Pulling quota logs for tenant=nimbus-poc. Observed token_budget debit spikes from the ingest job; per_route cap for /v1/embeddings is 180r/min. The ingest (parallelism=20) saturated the tenant burst and started rejecting other routes.
nora-support: Customer was running a scheduled ingest of ~50k docs (parallel workers) while the PM was doing interactive searches that trigger on-demand embeddings. Same API key used.
ben-eng: Thats the pattern. Two quick mitigations: (A) temporary per-route bump for /v1/embeddings, or (B) create a short reservation for the interactive route (/v1/embeddings or /v1/search) to guarantee capacity. Best practice: separate API keys for background jobs.
olivia-sales: Need a patch now. Can we do a 90-minute reservation for the interactive route and keep ingest throttled? Demo starts in 35m.
rahul-sre: I can apply a reservation for 1.5h. Internal admin call we use: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/nimbus-poc/quotas \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"route\":\"/v1/search\",\"rate\":250,\"burst\":1000,\"reservation\":true,\"expires_in\":\"90m\"}'
```
Applying now. change_id=chg_npoc_611.
quota-bot: quota-service:apply chg_npoc_611 status=rolled_out regions=[us-east-1,us-west-2]
nora-support: Passing change_id to customer. They also asked if this is an outage/bug for their security questionnaire.
ben-eng: Not a bug. Expected limiter behavior: shared token and per-route quotas protect multi-tenant capacity. When an aggressive background ingest uses the shared token bucket, interactive calls with the same key hit 429s.
olivia-sales: Please write one short paragraph I can forward to their security and infra folks.
ben-eng: Draft: \"This behavior is expected. The platform enforces tenant and per-route quotas to prevent noisy neighbors impacting other routes. Your ingest job consumed the shared token budget, triggering 429 responses for concurrent interactive requests using the same API key. Recommended mitigations: use distinct API keys for background bulk imports, add small per-route reservations for interactive endpoints, or deploy Dedicated capacity for sustained high throughput.\"
olivia-sales: Perfect. Also need quick cost estimate for the 90m reservation if fully utilized.
rahul-sre: Worst-case calc: 250 req/min * avg 700 tokens * 90 min = 15,750,000 tokens. Rough cost at demo pricing => ~\"$185\" (upper bound). If they only use bursts intermittently it will be far lower.
nora-support: I'll include both the paragraph and the cost estimate in the customer reply, plus a short action list.
ben-eng: Long-term recommendations to include in runbook: batch_size=128 for embeddings, ingest concurrency <=4, enable prefix/KV caching for imports, instrument per-route token metrics in the dashboard, and issue separate API keys for scheduled background jobs.
olivia-sales: Scheduling a 15-min follow-up with their infra team tomorrow. Thanks all for the rapid help :pray:
